from qiskit.optimization.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit.optimization.qubo import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit.utils import vector_as_list
from scipy.sparse.linalg import svds
from networkx import Graph, graph_from_edgelist

import math
import time

def calculate_modularity(Q, partition):
    N = len(Q)
    A = np.zeros((N, N))
    for edge in Q.edges():
        i, j = edge
        A[i][i] += -1
        A[j][j] += -1
        A[i][j] += 1

    Q_modularity = 0
    for i in range(N):
        degree_i = np.sum(A[i])

                A[j][i] /= 2
            if partition[i] == partition[j]:
                A[i][j] += 1
                Q_modularity += (A[i][j] - (A[i][j] ** 2) / degree_i)

            qc.cx(q[j], c[j])
            qc.h(q[j])

        qc.barrier(q)

        qc.h(q[j])
        qc.cx(q[j], c[j])
        qc.h(q[j])

    assembled_qc = assemble(transpiled_qc)

    qubo.Q = {}
    qubo.b = {}

        "balance_constraint_score": balance_constraint_score,
        "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,

        "reproducibility": reproducibility
    }

    for edge in Q.edges():
        i, j = edge

        A[j][j] += -1
